scope: Same controller, independent preset; environment presentation only. No production NavMesh, blocking, economy or battle changes.

terrain.inland_mask: coast distance >= 7m and closed pond edge distance >= pond_bank_width + 1m; all such ground has the same height
terrain.boundary_relief: Only sea bed/coastal drop and closed pond depression/bank. No grass hill or individual raised building pad.
terrain.layout: Seven source buildings form a compact settlement. Three iron, three gold and three native natural-stone fixtures form separate clusters; exact source-oriented bounds are checked for overlap. No small-rock cliff substitutes.
terrain.water: Separate sea 1.1m and closed pond 3.6m surfaces; low-cost depth-colour and noise normal presentation, not final water art

sources.historical_buildings: Assets/_Tests/EnvironmentShowcase/Settings/dark-frozen-source-record.json; historical accepted exports, not current master re-export
sources.natural_stone: art/environment/2026-10-14-free-source-review.json#boulder_01; untouched native LOD2/LOD3; natural stone candidate, not a user Tripo stone mine

source_policy: All mesh, UV, assembly transforms and material references preserved; only whole uniform placement scale and whole-root translation/rotation. No Blender source edits or new model creation.

display_diagnosis.materials: Actual source cutout base+alpha, Cull0, Cutoff0.5, coverage-preserving mipmaps; no confirmed channel/culling import failure. Runtime source bounds and on/off contribution recorded.
display_diagnosis.distance: Flat only: orthographic draw distance measured from ground focus, removing camera-elevation framing bias. Old modes retain their exact prior camera-XZ culling.
display_diagnosis.limitation: The measured plants still read as fine points/thin twigs at RTS range. Number or pixel contribution is not proof of a readable meadow/canopy. No style iteration, cutoff lowering or oversized scaling used to disguise missing art.

limitations: Suitable dense-crown whole trees missing; rejected high-polygon and unsuitable sparse-crown sources remain unused here.
Broader natural RTS-readable grass clumps and fuller shrub silhouettes missing; current approved small plants do not deliver the concept meadow.
Reeds/cattail shoreline clumps and long authored stratified cliff modules missing. Native Boulder is not a stretched/stacked cliff.
Mixed source licenses; gold/iron permission not independently verified. Local private review only, no public upload approval.
Art visual acceptance remains false, independent of technical check pass. Timings are environment-only on this machine, not battle or mass-unit performance.
